//: IntentGraph configuration — see docs/intentgraph.md. Resolution order: defaults → this file → environment → explicit args. Copy to <data_dir>/intentgraph.json or point INTENTGRAPH_CONFIG at it. NEVER put API keys in this file — all credentials come from environment variables.

embedding.//: none = semantic retrieval disabled, zero network (default). hash = deterministic local lexical projection (TEST/FALLBACK, not real semantics). nebius = Nebius Token Factory (https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/, OpenAI-compatible). nvidia = NVIDIA NIM (https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1, NVIDIA_API_KEY with nvapi-* keys; home of nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b). openai = any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM).
embedding.//model: REQUIRED for nebius/openai and never defaulted — accounts differ. Pick from `intentgraph embed --list-models` output.
embedding.//api_key: leave empty; the env vars win: for nebius NEBIUS_API_KEY → NEBIUS_TOKEN_FACTORY_KEY; for nvidia NVIDIA_API_KEY; generic INTENTGRAPH_EMBEDDING_API_KEY; openai also accepts OPENAI_API_KEY.

llm.//: Optional LLM-assisted retrieval planning (query decomposition + action selection). Deterministic policy is the default and ALWAYS the fallback on auth/rate-limit/schema failures.
llm.//model: e.g. a chat model your account serves (meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen/…); must be set when provider != none.

reranker.//: Optional remote reranking over Token Factory's POST /v1/rerank (vLLM-style). Model availability is ACCOUNT-DEPENDENT — verify yours with --list-models and the live smoke test; the API docs example is Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-8B (an example, not a guaranteed default).

web_search.//: Optional Tavily search (POST https://api.tavily.com/search). off by default. External results are never user memories; nothing is persisted unless store_results is true.
web_search.//enabled: gate for the adaptive controller's automatic use. false = zero automatic requests; `intentgraph websearch` stays available as an explicit manual search.
web_search.//max_calls_per_query: per-remember() budget for automatic searches (0 disables the automatic path).
web_search.//store_results: EXPLICIT opt-in to persist external findings as ordinary memory records with full external provenance (origin: external_search, url, provider, request id). Default false.

graphify.//: Optional path to a Graphify graph.json; records carrying graph_anchors then also retrieve through your code graph's neighborhoods.

retrieval.//weights: RRF fusion weights; graph lower on purpose — expansion is corroboration, not a primary source.

api.//: Loopback bind by default. A non-loopback bind REQUIRES api_key (the server refuses to start otherwise).

privacy.//: true = refuse EVERY remote provider class at load time: external embeddings, LLM planning, remote reranking, and enabled web search. The privacy hard-stop.
